newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Chenming Paper OPENS AT HK$7.80.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Chenming Paper OPENS AT HK$7.80.

text.p: Shandong Chenming Paper Holdings Ltd's 115 million B share issue opened up at HK$7.80 against an offer price of HK$4.43 on listing on the Shenzhen stock exchange on Monday with support from foreign securities firms, brokers said.
"Foreign securities houses are keen on new Chinese shares as they have strong potential," an analyst at a major western investment bank in Shenzhen said.
Chenming's listing follows robust debuts by three other B share firms listed in Shenzhen so far this year, the analyst said.
Wafangdian Bearing Co, pesticide maker Hubei Sanonda Co and Nanjing Posts & Telecommunication Equipment all gained more than 70 percent on their first trading day.
"But Chenming's shares seemed not to be valued on company performance," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said. "I think the price will slip."
Chenming initially issued 100 million B shares at HK$4.43 each earlier this month and later offered an additional 15 million shares.

Chenming said in its B share listing announcement that its biggest B share holder is Seapower Securities Ltd, which has 29.42 million B shares or 10.74 percent of Chenming's 273.86 million outstanding shares.
Chenming, one of China's top 10 paper producers, said it planned to use the B share issue proceeds to expand output.
Based in the city of Shouguang in eastern China's Shandong province, Chenming booked net profits of 122.9 million yuan for 1996 and 76.49 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
